scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && cp -r frontend/dist backend/public && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run format --prefix frontend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
